description: This file defines a Presenter class responsible for managing trace data, filtering, and UI updates in a trace viewer application. It processes trace entries, applies filters, and generates UI data structures for visualization.

classes.name: Presenter
classes.description: Manages trace data, filtering, and UI state for trace visualization.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Presenter with trace data and a callback for UI updates.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates current trace entry based on trace position.

methods.name: onVSyncIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates VSync ID filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onPidFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates PID filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onUidFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates UID filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onTypeFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates type filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onLayerIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates layer ID filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Updates specific ID filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onWhatSearchStringChanged
methods.description: Updates search string filter and recomputes UI data.

methods.name: onEntryClicked
methods.description: Handles UI entry click, toggling selection and updating properties tree.

methods.name: computeUiData
methods.description: Generates filtered UI data entries based on current filters.

methods.name: computeCurrentEntryIndex
methods.description: Calculates current entry index based on trace position.

methods.name: computeCurrentPropertiesTree
methods.description: Determines properties tree for current or selected entry.

methods.name: makeUiDataEntries
methods.description: Creates UI data entries from trace entries, including layers, displays, and other events.

methods.name: getUniqueUiDataEntryValues
methods.description: Extracts and sorts unique values from UI data entries for filtering options.
